description: Execute a shell command on a profile with approvalPolicy = "client-tool", where calling this tool is the approval: the MCP client asks the user before the call runs. Use it when run-command refuses a destructive or privileged command with APPROVAL_VIA_TOOL; it takes the same arguments. On a profile with any other approvalPolicy it runs nothing and points back at run-command (CLIENT_TOOL_ONLY). Single-line only: a command containing a line break is refused, so upload a multi-line script with sftp-upload and run it by path.

session.description: Run in an existing interactive session (stateful)

name: destructive-command
